verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Titan only as a sign-in and 2-Step Verification factor that works with Google and FIDO-compatible sites. Nothing shows it gating automated or agent-initiated actions behind a key touch. The probe confirms Titan ships no CLI, SDK, API or MCP surface of its own, so FIDO compatibility is at most a building block a developer could use to construct such approval flows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can require a physical key touch as the human-approval step for sensitive automated or agent-initiated actions
